title: Enhancing Exploration in Global Optimization by Noise Injection in the Probability Measures Space
summary: McKean-Vlasov (MKV) systems provide a unifying framework for recent state-of-the-art particlebased methods for global optimization. While individual particles follow stochastic trajectories, the probability law evolves deterministically in the mean-field limit, potentially limiting exploration in multimodal landscapes. We introduce two principled approaches to inject noise directly into the probability law dynamics: a perturbative method based on conditional MKV theory, and a geometric approach leveraging tangent space structure.
